messages:
paula: Heads-up — premerge SAST and DAST both started failing on ci.redwood with KMS decrypt denied when scanner pulls encrypted fixtures. CI: https://ci.redwood.example/build/5621 :warning:
tom: saw the alerts, any recent keystore or IAM changes overnight?
nina: we applied a tighter key policy at 23:40 UTC that scopes usage to exact service principals. KMS audit shows principalMismatch for ephemeral principals used by the scanner.
paula: log excerpt:
```
ERROR scanner: keystore.Decrypt failed: AccessDeniedException: Caller not authorized for key
  at keystore.Client.Decrypt (keystore.go:182)
  at scanner.Fixtures.Load (fixtures.go:49)
```
security-bot: evidence ticket created SEC-EVID-2026-115 — artifacts bucket: gs://sec-evidence/2026/115
paula: immediate priorities: preserve artifacts (I can grab them), snapshot key policy, get 2 approvers if we need a temporary policy unblock per keystore runbook.
tom: quick investigation: long-lived service accounts unaffected. Only ephemeral-grants tokens fail. KMS audit shows condition on key binding expecting `request.auth.principal == serviceAccount:keystore@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com` which ephemeral tokens do not match.
nina: long-term fix is to have ephemeral-grants mint tokens that impersonate or include a stable principal mapping. Short-term we can add a timeboxed binding that allows ephemeral-grants principal. I can draft minimal JSON for approval.
ops-bot: policy-change request noted. Per keystore policy we need two approvers from {security, platform} and an audit-id when applied.
paula: please paste patch and I'll ping approvers. Also we must create an incident record if we make policy changes.
nina: patch (conceptual): add member `serviceAccount:ephemeral-grants@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com` to `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter` with condition restricting `request.time < "2026-03-22T04:30:00Z"` and limiting to the project key resource.
tom: I approve the temporary policy change to unblock CI. :+1:
paula: I approve as security lead provided we attach approvals and keep window minimal. :white_check_mark:
ops-bot: applying policy change now... (will emit audit-id when done)
ops-bot: policy patch applied by nina at 00:12 UTC (audit-id: q1w2e3). CI re-triggered.
security-bot: incident record created SEC-INC-2026-40 responders: paula, tom, nina.
paula: CI build 5622 shows scanners passing. https://ci.redwood.example/build/5622 :rocket:
tom: follow-ups: 1) PR for ephemeral-grants to impersonate keystore SA (owner: nina) 2) add CI preflight step to validate KMS decrypt before SAST/DAST run (owner: paula) 3) add key-policy diff check to deploy checklist (owner: platform).
nina: will open the PR with unit + integration tests against staging KMS and include a migration plan.
paula: I'll draft incident postmortem and link SEC-EVID-2026-115 and SEC-INC-2026-40. Keeping this thread as canonical evidence chain.
summary: Premerge SAST/DAST blocked by KMS key policy that excluded ephemeral tokens; temporary timeboxed key binding added after approvals to unblock CI; artifacts preserved and incident logged; follow-ups include impersonation for ephemeral-grants and CI preflight checks.
